{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("Sample of revenue values:", data['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for the presence of non-numeric revenue
non_numeric_revenue = data[~data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').str.replace('.', '', regex=False).str.isnumeric()]
print(f"Number of non-numeric revenue entries: {len(non_numeric_revenue)}")"}
